notes: Primary pain: inconsistent relevancy for research queries across large document set; current infra expensive at scale.
They run nightly ingestion of 1M+ documents (SEC filings, research notes, transcripts) — expect 10M initial corpus.
Latency SLO: p95 <= 220ms for short queries (1-2 chunk hits), p95 <= 500ms for multi-doc rerank workflows.
Cost target: <$0.015 per user query at scale (embeddings + rerank combined) — very cost sensitive on per-query economics.
Model preferences: open/quantized embedding model (cost-aware) + smaller dense retriever; ranking model can be larger but isolated to Dedicated pool.
Routing: need region-aware routing (US + EU residency) and deterministic fallback to smaller model under load.
Security ask: customer-managed KMS (HSM-backed), full audit logs, retention controls, and ability to host Private control plane in VPC.
Quote from CTO Jaime: "We cannot allow raw text of EU clients to leave EU regions — key ownership non-negotiable."
SE notes: consider hybrid approach — Dedicated for rerank + Private/VPC control plane for metadata and ingress to satisfy residency
Observed: current vector DB vendor charging premium for 10M+ vectors and charging per-closest-neighbors; client wants flat tokenized cost predictability.
Will run embedding-quality comparisons (SBERT baseline -> Redwood recommended open-quantized) during POC.
